//: From the Backrooms Wiki. Deathmoths leave it behind (br_deathmoth_drops). A sweet food that mends a few hit points.
description: A glob of pale, faintly glowing jelly scraped from a deathmoth.  It smells like warm honey and tastes sweeter than it has any right to.  People in the Backrooms swear a mouthful takes the sting out of cuts and bruises.

//: u ate moth jelly: a few hit points back on every body part.

effect.u_message: Sweet and warm.  The ache in your bruises eases a little.

//: What a dead deathmoth leaves: sometimes a glob or two of moth jelly.
From the Backrooms Wiki. Burns as lamp fuel (ammo type lamp_oil): oil lamps and the Flamero-Mado spear take it like kerosene. Level 2 finds.
description: Coarse red crystals that feel warm in the hand.  Crushed into a lamp or a fuel tank they smoulder and burn like kerosene, without the smell.  The tunnel crews on Level 2 trade it by the handful.

//: From the Backrooms Wiki. A rare, light, never-spoiling bar worth most of a day's food.
description: A plain foil-wrapped bar with no brand and no writing, about the size of a deck of cards.  Whatever you were hoping for, it tastes like that: a roast dinner, a birthday cake, your grandmother's soup.  One keeps you going for most of a day.

//: From the Backrooms Wiki. Turns up in almond water bottles; drinking it is agony (pain +40, a bad mood). A trap for the careless reader.
description: A bottle of slightly cloudy liquid.  It looks just like almond water, but the smell is sharp rather than sweet, like pennies and struck matches.

//: u drank liquid pain: a wave of pain and a lasting bad mood.

effect.u_message: That wasn't almond water.  Fire runs down your throat and into every joint at once.
